english.note: Use this when the hypocrisy involves putting on a show of moral kindness or righteousness.

examples.english: They hypocritically donated money and even asked people to take photos for the newspaper.
examples.traditional: 佢假仁假義咁捐錢，仲要叫人影相登報。
